extracted.name: Spinach Watermelon Salad
extracted.description: This spinach watermelon salad with salty feta and sweet tomatoes is tossed with a homemade balsamic vinaigrette for a refreshing summer salad.
instruction_lines: Whisk olive oil, white balsamic vinegar, and salt together in a small bowl; set aside.
Combine arugula, spinach, onions, and tomatoes in a large salad bowl. Drizzle vinaigrette over salad mixture; toss to coat. Add feta cheese and watermelon to serve.
